5. **New Example 9: Thermal expansion with npt_ber** — explicit multi-temperature NPT pattern → fixes WO_gpumdnep_004 intermittent
6. **heat_lan variant in Example 6** (input_examples.md) — makes Langevin NEMD equally visible with selection criteria
